stories.title: Meta settles social media addiction case with states for up to $18 billion
stories.reason: A 29-state coalition forced Meta into mandatory teen safety changes -- daily time limits, a midnight-to-6am night mode -- alongside one of the largest tech settlements ever.

stories.title: Trump and Xi discuss Iran in wide-ranging call as US presses China and others to break from Tehran
stories.reason: The call came as US and Iranian officials agreed to high-level talks Friday in Oman, a possible de-escalation signal even as sanctions pressure intensifies.

stories.title: OpenAI's Jalapeño AI chip brings new 'threat' to Nvidia margins as custom silicon gains ground
stories.reason: OpenAI's self-reported benchmarks claim up to 1.9x more throughput than Blackwell systems, landing just hours before Nvidia's own earnings report.

stories.title: Nvidia earnings: live updates and commentary
stories.reason: Nvidia reports fiscal Q2 results after today's close, with ~$92 billion in revenue expected -- a result that will set the tone for the entire AI trade.

stories.title: Canada strikes back in a trade war with the U.S.
stories.reason: Ottawa's formal countertariffs on roughly $20 billion of US goods took a further step today as the trade dispute between the two allies deepens.
